key_reasoning.reason: Direction changed mid-run: CodeMie viewer Full/Focus buttons were built and then reverted once the user clarified that the hosted deck's own controls were the target. Rework actually happened, so L.

The UI diff loosens iframe permissions: fullscreen is delegated through the outer viewer frame and the inner container frame (allow=fullscreen restricted to the content origin) and allow-popups is added to both sandboxes. The closest pattern was the existing sandbox/allow attributes, but they did not cover the security tradeoff of widening the permissions. A security sign-off and live checks against two backends were needed. Base M, raised to L by the security red flag.

In the UI repo, two components changed (HostedApplicationViewer and the createHostedFrame util). A companion backend change was also needed in codemie content.py (Permissions-Policy fullscreen=(self), CSP sandbox allow-popups), so the scope is M rather than S.

The diffstat shows 5 UI files (2 source, 3 tests, +29/-6), which maps to M. The companion backend change adds 4 more files (+48/-16) in a separate repo. That is not counted in this band but supports the score not being lower.
The UI iframe layer plus backend response headers (API/content serving), coordinated across two codebases. This is a standard two-layer path, so M.
